problem: Semantic mapping and scene-graph systems (HOV-SG, ConceptGraphs) assume stable camera motion, static environments and coarse object geometry, so they fail for humanoids whose gait blurs observations, whose maps become stale after object relocation, and who need surface geometry for safe manipulation poses.
motivation: Humanoids must navigate to a terminal stance from which manipulation is collision-free, reachable and stable. Bipedal torso oscillation corrupts RGB-D mapping, and map-once-query-forever memory sends the robot to obsolete coordinates in human environments that change.
key_idea: Maintain three coupled fields (confidence-gated semantic 3DGS appearance, a scene-graph spatial memory revised locally when a reliability-gated discrepancy score exceeds a threshold, and on-demand flow-matching mesh geometry for Interaction Pose Safety checks) in a closed perception-adaptation loop.
insight: Reliability weighting derived from Gaussian gradient/opacity instability suppresses gait artifacts in rendering, graph construction and change detection alike. Without the gate, fast-walk PSNR drops to 21.6 dB vs 29.8 and the change-detection FPR is 46.5% vs 4.2%. Local revision adds a lot beyond local perception alone: relocation SR rises from 64% (MIF Initial) to 94% (Post-Update). Continuous meshes make IPS collision checks more reliable than Gaussian-centroid point clouds (62% vs 94% IPS success).
method: Jitter-aware confidence: per-Gaussian C_i from normalized gradient magnitude and opacity through a smooth gate (beta=5, gamma=2); it weights feature alpha-blending, centroid back-projection and node reliability Omega.
Feature distillation: CLIP/DINOv2 features compressed to 32-D per Gaussian with a co-trained MLP decoder, giving under 4 GB VRAM and 1.6 s latency.

Stabilized re-perception and Spatial Field: render stabilized views from smoothed virtual trajectories; GPT-4o parses them into a scene graph (nodes with caption, room, reliability, confidence-weighted centroid; relation edges); hierarchical Region/Landmark/Object grounding follows HOV-SG.

Discrepancy-triggered local update: D = mean of Omega-weighted (position + semantic cosine) node shifts plus w_rel times the Jaccard distance of edge sets; if D > tau=0.45 (chosen by ROC), the robot actively scans and patches only the affected Gaussians and graph nodes, then replans.
Task-local view selection Q(k): scores hemisphere viewpoints by distance, optical-axis alignment and mean node reliability to choose conditioning views.
Geometry Field: pre-trained SAM-3D-style flow-matching transformer (25 steps, ~6.2 s, async) generates an object mesh, aligned to the Gaussian support with scale-invariant ICP.

IPS verification and stability-aware planning: S_IPS = collision margin (>5 cm signed distance) AND collision-free IK reachability AND CoM inside the support polygon; Pure Pursuit with velocity scaling reduces torso oscillation.

setting.backbone: Incremental 3DGS SLAM (GS-SLAM-style) + CLIP/DINOv2 features + GPT-4o (frozen) for scene graph and query parsing + pre-trained SAM-3D flow-matching transformer (frozen)
setting.training_data: Per-scene online optimization of Gaussians and a feature decoder; pre-trained foundation models used frozen; no dedicated training dataset
setting.observation: Egocentric RGB-D (RealSense D435i, 640x480, 30 Hz) with SLAM pose
setting.action_space: Velocity commands (v, omega) via Pure Pursuit stability-aware local planner, with stance micro-adjustments

numbers_note: All results are from a private real-world office on a Unitree G1, with no standard navigation benchmark. Trial counts are not stated. Other tables (rendering PSNR/SSIM, graph recall/precision/mAP, tau ROC) are omitted from the numbers.
results: On a real Unitree G1, MIF reaches 92% semantic grounding success (vs 74% HOV-SG) and 94% IPS success with 0% collisions (vs 78% static mesh). After scene changes it reaches 94/98/86% relocation/removal/addition success, versus HOV-SG's 12/10/0%, the ConceptGraphs+Rescan and Khronos baselines (38% and ~18% relocation), and 64/68/42% without memory revision. The 32D features cut VRAM to under 4 GB (the abstract's 91.4% memory reduction) with a fast-walk SR of 86%.
limitations: Geometry generation takes ~6.2 s and everything relies on an offboard RTX 4090 workstation.
Evaluation is in a single ~100 m^2 office with unstated trial counts, and some baselines are approximate (~) or adapted, so the comparison is not standardized.
The system stacks many modules (GPT-4o, SAM-3D, 3DGS SLAM), with individual components lacking thorough ablations, e.g. of Q(k) view selection.
